title: Remote viewer sees Tunguska as an exploding saucer of escapees

tellings.quote: >> He says it was um uh people in a saucer.

related.note: This is the same 1908 Tunguska event, but McMoneagle's remote viewing explains it as an exploding saucer carrying escapees, not a natural air burst.

plain: The giant explosion over Tunguska in Siberia in 1908 was, according to a remote viewing session, a saucer full of people, escapees, that blew up. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this is what the remote viewer Joe McMoneagle saw when he turned his mind to the event: "people in a saucer." If true, the famous blast was not a natural air burst but a crashed craft.
